title: Keys To Exalting A Nation
paragraphs: God's divine purpose from the beginning was to establish a nation from heaven on earth. That was God's original idea. His plan and purpose in creating the Earth was for humanity to inhabit it. Secondly, God’s divine goal was to establish a heavenly colony on Earth. So, God's vision was that there should be a nation on earth from heaven. He wanted to do that to establish a colony of heaven on earth. His divine goal was to establish the culture of heaven on earth.

You must write down all of this because this is the greatest message you can share with anyone, which is that God’s plan, idea, and original intention was to establish a country and nation from Heaven on Earth to demonstrate Heaven’s culture on Earth. His strategy was to achieve this by establishing a heavenly government on earth. Therefore, government is the key to establishing any nation. The primary purpose of government is to establish and administer the law that governs life in the nation.

It also produces the culture of that nation. This last statement is probably the most important one I will be giving you all night. What is the primary purpose of government? Here's the answer. The purpose of government is to make and administer the law, and this law regulates people’s lives, and this life produces the culture in that country. So I want you to see the relationship between government, law, people, and culture. The government makes the law. The law regulates people's lifestyles.

This lifestyle becomes the culture. Therefore, the most important component in any country is actually the government, because the government controls what happens in the country and what the country becomes. The government also controls people and what they become, because the law regulates people's lifestyles. Is this clear? Therefore, any entity that makes the law is a dangerous group of people, because they regulate and create reality through the law. This then leads me to the next point.

The fact that we were created to rule the earth. God did this because He knew that in order for the earth to become like heaven, He had to put us on earth and make everything under our control. Then He gave us His law to be the law of the land. Let us read from the Constitution of Heaven, Psalm 8, verse 4, for those who are religious. Psalm 8, verse 4: David was king. He was not a religious man. But he was actually a politician. David asked a question. What is man that your mind should be filled with him?

Oh God, why do you think so much about human beings? What is so important about the Son of Man that you care about what happens to him and what he does? David answers the question himself. He says: I know why we are so important. You have made us a little less than yourself. That word refers to beings, and it is the word "Elohim". It means God. Then what did you crown us with? Say it out loud. Glory and honor. You have learned that you must not touch the glory of God. This is a religious phrase.

This is not a statement from the perspective of the Kingdom. The Kingdom actually says that you have been given the glory of God. What does glory mean? It's the word " Kabud". It is actually related to nature or culture. I have been crowned with the culture of God. And by the nature of God. Well, that makes sense. If God wanted the nature of heaven to come to earth, he had to put it in the creatures that he put on earth. Because culture is not on Earth. But in humans. No part of your country has a culture.

Humans are the bearers of culture. Culture is the glory of peoples. That's the true nature of people. So, whatever the people's situation, it's what happens on Earth. The Bible says that He crowned you with what? Glory. And here's the big thing? Dignity. This means that God has placed you in a high position. Dignity means elevation, high esteem, and respect. The Bible says that He crowned you with glory, that is, the culture of God, and honor. God actually respects his creatures. He respects his children.

He is proud of us. He says: "Go ahead and take control of the land." Look at the following phrase. What are you saying? You have given him dominion over the works of your hands, and you have put everything under the feet of man. Do you need any more convincing about why God put you here? You did not come from Earth. You came to Earth. You are from heaven. She was sent here to rule the earth on behalf of God, to bring the glory of God, the nature of God, and the culture of God to the earth.

Therefore, you are the first and only government that God has put on Earth. To rule means, of course, that you carry out the elimination of a territory. The judiciary is about the law. This means that you apply the laws of your country to the environment in which you live. So God placed you here, and placed some things under your feet? everything. This means every animal, every dog, every cat, every plant, every gold, silver, oil, oceans, mountains, trees.

You must rule the physical planet and subject it to the influence of the Heavenly Culture. That's why you were sent here. So you are the first government, so what is the purpose of government? Write this down. The essence of government is the law. Please remember this. The essence of government is the law. Governments do many things and you think these things are important, but the most important thing a government does is debate, legislation, and passing laws.

Currently, we have some legislation before our parliamentarians concerning important issues, and perhaps some of you do not realize the magnitude of what is happening. That's why you should say something because they are about to pass a law. When you think about government, you should think about the law. This is why power-hungry people in any country want access to Congress or the House of Representatives, because these are the bodies of power that make legislation that becomes law.

Therefore, everyone wants to control the lawmaking process. This leads us to the second point. Write it down. Whoever controls or makes the law, makes the nation. Never ignore the people who fight for the laws. Some of you, for example, are wondering why there are so many people in our countries around us now trying to fight for laws that protect same-sex marriage, for example. This matter should not be underestimated. They do not care about your prayer meetings. They don't care about your discussions in church.

They want to make sure it becomes law. Because once it becomes law, the nation becomes a nation that adopts that kind of relationship. Government is about the law, and the law makes the nation. This leads me to the third point. The law creates and controls culture. What did you say? The law creates and controls culture. A nation becomes what it will become based on the laws that the people in power make. That group is called the government. They govern the nation with laws, and it is the law that produces culture.

This leads us to point four. So, the first thing God gave Moses when he wanted to create a nation of slaves was the law. God gave the law to Moses before He gave him the land. Because God knew that if you got land without law, it might become an anarchic land. You cannot regulate the land unless you have a law. Therefore, God gave the law to Moses first. Then the people got the land after that. This leads us to point number five. Whoever controls the drafting of the law controls the quality of the nation.

Who controls what? Drafting the law. They will control the quality of the nation. Once again, she wonders why people want to stay in positions of power. Because when you are in a position of power to create and influence the organization of the state, you are in fact controlling the quality of the state and its values. You control the moral standards of the country. This brings us to point number six, which I believe is extremely dangerous. The rule of law is at the mercy of those who control the law.

This is a quote by Miles Munro. Tweet it to someone now. I'll say it again. The rule of law is at the mercy of those who control the law. Democracy, for example, prides itself on being a philosophy of the rule of law. What they mean by that is that the law governs the country. But we forget that the law that governs the country is made by men who control the law. Therefore, saying that the law governs the country does not necessarily mean that you have the right country; you may have the wrong law governing it.

This is how dangerous governments are. Governments can actually control the rules. She can actually change the rules. They have the power to legislate and even advocate for changing the constitution, because once you control the law, the law can control you. So yes, we believe in the rule of law, but the question is, who controls the law? They can change the law. Have you ever wondered why the Bible calls God's laws " ordinances"? Do you know why they are called obligations?

The word " statue" has the same origin as the word "attribute" or "characteristic". It resembles that statue in the center of your city. There is a lady in the city center of our country. She has been sitting there all my life, and many of you were born while she was there. You will die. And she will remain there. It has been there for almost 180 years. She never moved. What is it called? statue. God used this term to describe His word and His law. He said that my laws are commandments.

This means you cannot change it by voting. You do not modify it by any act made by the human mind. That woman sitting in our courtyard, what is her name? Queen Victoria. Queen Victoria. She has been through every hurricane in the Bahamas. Am I right? She never moved. In other words, currents were flowing around her, but she withstood all the currents. And when the currents ended, it remained exactly the same. As you can see, there are many... Have you ever heard of this expression...

What is " trending" (the trend) in your society? Many things are just streams. This means it comes to move you. Governments need to understand which laws should not be enacted. The only laws you can guarantee will not be changed are those you receive from the Creator. There are some things that the Creator has set up and we tamper with them. I learned something years ago. If you went downtown to that woman, Queen Victoria, and said to her, " I hate you."

You clenched your fist and punched her in the face with all your might because you wanted to change her. What will happen to your fist? She will be in a pitiful state of blood. Do you know why? Whatever you do, she won't follow you. You are the one who follows it. You don't break it, it breaks you. All principles and laws are of this nature. You are not breaking God's laws. Instead, you break yourself over it.

No matter how hard we try to change the established laws of nature, or the fixed physiological facts, it is we who will break, not the laws. That's why I don't panic when I see people trying to shout at God and saying to God, "This is what we're going to do." Whatever you say, I smile because I know that you cannot change a divine law, and divine laws are always manifested in natural law, and natural law does not respect human law. This is extremely important.

Therefore, the rule of law is at the mercy of those who make the law, and for this reason even laws made by humans cannot be trusted. This then leads me to what happened when Adam fell. First and foremost, the first thing God gave to Adam was government. The word " sovereignty" as we know means the authority of the kingdom. God said to Adam: "Have dominion over the earth." We just read it in Psalm 8: 4 where God said, "I have been given dominion over the earth."

Therefore, God gave Adam government first and foremost. Why? Because the government is the most important component in leading or influencing any territory. At least we get to the second point: when Adam disobeyed God, he committed a great betrayal. This means that God entrusted Adam with authority. When trust in authority is violated, this is called betrayal. The consequence of betrayal is death.

Therefore, the fall of man was not only a loss for his family, but also a loss of his relationship with the government of Heaven, that is, diplomatic relations. The government's commitment to the land has also been lost. Thus, the fall of humanity was a summons to the ruler of Heaven. Who is the Spirit of God? The Holy Spirit has been sent here with us to be the ruler of the colony. When we disobeyed the laws of heaven, the ruler left.

Thus, the fall of man was the loss of the government of the Kingdom of Heaven on Earth. So we have lost a government. Thus, we have lost the nation of Heaven. And remember, we are trying to discover how you can restore the glory of nations once again? How can the nation be made heavenly again, or similar to heaven? Well, how was the nation originally heavenly? Is this the correct word? Heavenly. The original nation that was here with Adam was heavenly because the ruler of heaven lived in it. Holy Spirit.

Adam was guided by the Holy Spirit, not by his body. When Adam followed his flesh, he lost that influence coming from heaven. The Bible says that the Holy Spirit can no longer contend with humans. And so the Holy Spirit departed. Is this clear? When the Holy Spirit left the earth, the government left the earth. Just as in the Bahamas, Jamaica, Barbados, St. Kitts, St. Thomas, St. Lucia, or anywhere else, wherever a colony is found, the moment you disobey your ruling kingdom, the governor is summoned.

This happened here in the Bahamas in 1973. When that governor is summoned, the influence of that government disappears. The last British governor was here in 1973. When that governor left, we lost control of Great Britain over us. Therefore, there is nothing in the Bahamas that is under English control. So when you get rid of a ruler, you get rid of the government. When the Holy Spirit left the earth because of our rebellion against God, the government of heaven left the earth. Is this clear?

Therefore, God's goal was to restore that government. Now we know what God has done, don't we? God called a man named Abraham. Of course, Noah, as you know, was the one who called him to save humanity. But then God called a man named Abraham. What did God say to Abraham? Let's look at Genesis 18:18. It is very important to read what God said to him. God says, "Abraham, you will surely become great and strong, what?" A nation. "This is important. There is no religion called Judaism. God's plan was never a religion.

Abraham is not the founder of a religion. He is the father of a nation. And God says, 'O Abraham, I will make you into a great and powerful nation.'" Apparently, there are two things that make a nation successful: greatness and strength. Now, we have to figure out how to become great and how to become strong. And God tells Abraham how to do that. He goes on to say, “And all the nations of the earth will be blessed through you.” " Can I put it another way? All the nations of the earth will be influenced by you.

Can I put it another way? All the other nations will take you as their standard. Why? God wanted only one nation on earth. Why? Because He only has one race on earth. The only race God has on earth is called humankind. There is no white race, or black, or red, or brown, or yellow. In the Bible, there is only one race. It is humankind. And God wants this race to be the government on earth. We have lost that government.

So God says, 'Abraham, since I have lost all the peoples and nations on earth, I will use you as a prototype to be the standard for all nations.' And we know what happened. Of course, Moses took on that responsibility later and went to God with the people. Now, look at Exodus 19:5. Continuing the process, God says, 'If you obey me completely and keep my covenant, then out of all the nations you will be what? Mine out of all the nations, and all the earth is mine.

Even though I own everything, you as a nation will be to me a kingdom of priests, and what? A nation Holy. Again, God never told Moses to establish a religion. He's after what? A nation. Now, what's our topic for this session? The glorification of a nation. God cares about the Bahamas, not churches. Wow. Quiet. Now, look at this. See, the problem is that we've focused so much on going to heaven that we've forgotten our mission on earth. And religion actually ignores the earth in its theology.

God's first command to man was to rule over what? The earth, not to go to heaven. We came from heaven. God says, " This issue is about your influence on the earth and becoming the nation that rules the earth, the ruling power on the earth." So God told Moses, " Tell them, I will make them a royal priesthood." This means a vertical relationship with God and a holy nation. This is horizontal influence over people. A priest means the person who stands between God and the earth. Do you understand?

A nation means influence on the earth. So a holy priesthood means that the people who rule the earth must have a vertical relationship with God. Do you? Are you following along? So, kingship and priesthood are linked. Kingship and priesthood. Priesthood means a vertical relationship. Kingship means a horizontal influence. Everyone say it with me. You must write this down. A priest means what? A vertical relationship. Kingship means what? Horizontal.

So, in order to fulfill God's will as a ruler on Earth, I must first have a relationship with God. That is the priestly relationship. Then I can exert a royal influence on Earth. That is the horizontal aspect. So, every leader in our country must first have a vertical relationship with God. Then they can be trusted to have a horizontal influence on our country and our lives. Therefore, we should not only trust people who have the power to rule on Earth.

We must trust people who first have a relationship with the Power in Heaven. Yes. You will be what? First, a kingdom of priests. A kingdom is a state, a ruling state, the government of a country. And the holy nation is the one whose people are influenced by these priests. So, in God's mind, there is no difference between a priest and a king. The king is a priest, and the priest is a king. And in the Old Testament, if you read the Bible carefully, this is very interesting. Well, the person who installed the king was always the prophet. The prophet installed the king. Which means that the person with the vertical relationship gave permission to the person with the horizontal relationship. Samuel laid his hands on David and Saul. And that's how it should be. Ah, we have it differently in our modern countries. We go to the Attorney General or somewhere else to get our authority.

In other words, the principle is that governance begins with relationship. Mark my words. Governance begins with what? With relationship. If you have relationship, you are qualified to govern. It means you have a relationship with God, so that you are in contact with the laws of Heaven and don't violate the laws of Heaven with the laws of Earth.

And again, this is how you create a nation that glorifies the Lord. And God says: You better tell the country this whole program. Now, I want you to look at The point. What is a nation? What is a nation? We're talking about a nation. Mark my words. A nation is a community of people bound by a shared heritage, a shared language, a shared land, shared wisdom, shared ideals, shared values, and these people are subject to the rule of one God.

Now, this last part, we as a nation claim to believe in Him, while the path we take leads to multiple gods. A number of gods, it seems. In our country, we've decided: one God. This means it's very difficult to have an atheist in parliament in our country because, according to the aspirations of our constitution and also our national anthem, which embodies the desire we sing, someone who doesn't believe in one God cannot lead us.

So, anyone who is an atheist in their theological view of life shouldn't govern our country if it wants one God. And that's an important definition. Let me tell you why God did what He did. When God brought the people out of Egypt, He said to Moses, " I want to make a nation out of them." The first thing God gave them was a list of laws, the Ten Commandments. That was It is the foundation for establishing God's model nation. It was a list of laws. But what is important about these laws?

Perhaps you have forgotten this. The first law is part of the Ten Commandments. The first law in the Ten Commandments is what? You shall have no other gods before me. God began with God. He did not begin with "Do not steal, do not kill, do not lie," etc. Rather, He said: First and foremost, let us make clear who the supreme authority is. Because if the nation does not declare its God, the laws become subject to the mercy of men. Yes, sir. Without an ultimate authority, everything becomes relative.

Without fear, there can be no wisdom. My God, am I starting to lose your attention? Well. If there is no God to fear, you will do anything. That is why the fear of God is the beginning of wise choices. That is what it means. If you fear breaking the law of your authority, they will discipline you when making laws. And that is why people who want to change God's laws always try to get rid of God first. So they expel God from parliament, the senate, the law, the courts, and the schools.

Because if I can get rid of God, I won't have to worry about Displeasing any authority. That way I can make any law I want. That's why the first thing God gave Moses was the law. But the first law he gave him was about what? The God they were to worship. That's why it's so important for nations to have a clear reference to God. May I put it to you then?

What makes a nation a nation? This is very important. First, one land. One land. Second, one national vision. Third, one language. One language. Fourth, one constitution. Fifth, one common legal system. Sixth, one government. Let me comment on this for a minute. We have an island in the Bahamas.

And that's the reason for the confusion on that island in the Bahamas. And that confusion manifests itself in the people.
